title: 醒啦

keys.prompt:
Make ONE precise production keyframe sheet of NINE sequential animation illustrations. EXACTLY 3 columns and 3 rows of 512x512 SQUARE cells, total 1536x1536; read row major. Invisible equal grid divisions, absolutely no written text, numbers, lettering, panel frames or gutters. Each cell has exactly the same fixed lens, solid opaque pure WHITE background, mild safe margins and fixed ground line. Draw the reference character(s) large, with the same recognizable face design, costume, hair and accessories across the 9 cells. Only characters requested in the story. Draw graphic chibi animation cels with clean shapes, not a close-up collage, no motion blur. Each cell must show a DIFFERENT complete acting pose. This is one story with a readable pay-off and reset, including hands, gaze and props. At small chat scale every pose reads. STORY: Nailü right wakes a dozing Xingtong left. X slumps and scrunches in a nightmare. N glances over, reaches to gently pat her shoulder, X startles upright, recognizes N, their shoulders ease and both breathe out. X settles back into the opening doze.
NINE chronological drawings: 1) 0.00 s: Draw Xingtong seated left, eyes closed and chin drooping, both hands on her thighs; Nailü sits right, looking forward with both hands on her thighs. 2) 0.60 s: Deepen Xingtong's slump, pinch her brows and scrunch her shoulders; turn Nailü's eyes and head toward her. 3) 1.15 s: Keep Xingtong tightly hunched; lift Nailü's left hand toward Xingtong's right shoulder, palm open, while her right hand stays on her thigh. 4) 1.65 s: Place Nailü's left palm gently on Xingtong's right shoulder for a soft pat; keep Xingtong's eyes squeezed shut and hands planted. 5) 2.05 s: Snap Xingtong upright with wide eyes and raised shoulders, looking ahead; let Nailü's palm follow the rising shoulder without gripping. 6) 2.55 s: Turn Xingtong's gaze toward Nailü in recognition and soften her brows; lift Nailü's left palm just clear of the shoulder as she smiles back. 7) 3.10 s: Lower both characters' shoulders and chests in a shared exhale; return Nailü's left hand to her thigh as Xingtong's eyelids soften. 8) 3.75 s: Let Xingtong's eyes close and chin descend toward her opening doze; turn Nailü's gaze forward, keeping all four hands on their thighs. 9) 4.50 s: Settle Xingtong into a relaxed doze with her chin slightly higher than in pose one; hold Nailü's opening posture for the final gentle downward drift.
Continuity: Use one fixed full-body composition without props throughout the 4.8-second loop, preserving hand paths and gaze changes, with distinct pose nine easing into pose one. ATTACHMENT AUTHORITY: the left subject is directly illustrated from the real Bilibili official pack Xingtong 好欸好欸 and 对对对: use her squat round silver-grey bob shape, big angular silver side-swept bang, small loop-shaped crossing slim hairpins on the viewer-right, dark plum tapered ink, broad warm red cheeks, low-set eyes with lively lash detail, dark navy sleeves and white sailor collar with powder-blue trim. Closely follow the shape and color blocks in the small original stickers. Omit their printed writing and onomatopoeia. Do not use generic idol character design. Where the reference shows no pupils for a gag, preserve that deliberate feature in the nod; ordinary open eyes of Xingtong are blue. Nailü, whenever requested, uses the taupe, green, white-flower figure at RIGHT of the guide. Do not draw the attachment collage as a new scene. Nailü has exactly ONE brown HEART-SHAPED COWLICK attached to the top of the head. Hair flowers and green bang streak match the right-side guide; absolutely NO floating green wavy symbols above her head. Her eye direction and smiles vary with the scene.

No grids, numbering, words, motion trails, crossfades or double hands. The attached four rows give A, B, B, C. Create TWO successive micro-actions: top TWO rows are SIX evenly spaced DIFFERENT complete inbetween poses from the first reference A toward B, bottom TWO rows are SIX from B toward C. The six progress values in EACH block are about 10%,26%,42%,58%,74%,90%. Source extremes are supplied separately in the final GIF, so fill ALL cells with precision motion, never six identical drawings. Follow bright clean line art and maintain exact registration and hand identity; no autonomous camera shake. Full story for context: Nailü right wakes a dozing Xingtong left. X slumps and scrunches in a nightmare. N glances over, reaches to gently pat her shoulder, X startles upright, recognizes N, their shoulders ease and both breathe out. X settles back into the opening doze.
A = 0.00 s: Draw Xingtong seated left, eyes closed and chin drooping, both hands on her thighs; Nailü sits right, looking forward with both hands on her thighs.
B = 0.60 s: Deepen Xingtong's slump, pinch her brows and scrunch her shoulders; turn Nailü's eyes and head toward her.
C = 1.15 s: Keep Xingtong tightly hunched; lift Nailü's left hand toward Xingtong's right shoulder, palm open, while her right hand stays on her thigh.
Trust the actual illustrated poses in the attachment for the shape, timing and exact action. Preserve figure count and source costume. Never place hands, limbs or extra flowers into adjacent cells.
